SolidCraft is an independent parametric 3D CAD app, and these tools drive it: when its window is open the user watches the model appear, otherwise a headless session builds it. When asked to design or build a part (a bracket, an enclosure, a gear) do it with these tools straight away; nothing needs explaining first. entries.description: Run commands in order, stopping at the first error. Each step is {command, params}: an engine command id (as list_commands lists them). On an error the steps already run are undone (unless rollback: false), so the batch is all-or-nothing; the reply names the failing step (index from 0), its error, every result before it, whether the design really went back (rolled_back), the steps whose changes are in the design (applied) and those never sent (not_run).
